decisive_items: Regular narrow QRS tachycardia (QRS duration, 60 milliseconds) at a ventricular rate of 103-125 beats/min
Regular P waves evident marching onto QRS complexes at a rate of 100-125 beats/min with mean cycle length of 517.16 milliseconds with varying PR intervals
response.rationale: Both candidates are supported by similar ECG findings, but supraventricular tachycardia is a broader category that encompasses various types of tachycardias, including atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia, making it a more general diagnosis without additional specific evidence pointing to a reentrant mechanism.

rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for reentrant mechanism
